[Back to all emotions](index.qmd)

Love connects us to people, places, ideas, values, and communities that matter.

## It can give us the urge to

- connect;
- care; or
- stay close.

## It may be telling us

- a person matters deeply;
- a group or value matters; or
- we want to support well-being.

## What can help

1. Show care.
2. Respect boundaries.
3. Offer useful support.
4. Let others care for you too.

## Design connection

Rounded symbols, friendly characters, and handwritten forms can create warmth and affection.

**Examples:** Hallmark, Sanrio, and Build-A-Bear.
